sentences.text:
Shanti Parkash And Anr vs State Of J&K And Ors on 8 April,
2025
 S. No. 05
 High Court Of Jammu & Kashmir And Ladakh

Petitioner(s)
 Through: Mr. Bupinder Anthal, Advocate vice
q
 Mr. Ankur Sharma, Advocate.

vs
State of J&K and ors. ..... Respondent(s)
 Through: Ms. Chetna Manhas, Advocate vice
 Mrs. Monika Kohli, Sr. Aag.
 Ms. Nisha Kangotra, Advocate vice
 Mr. Ravinder Gupta, Aag.

Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Wasim Sadiq Nargal, Judge
 Order
08.04.2025
1.

The instant petition has been preferred by the petitioners way back in the year 2018, in which a prayer has been made against the respondents to compensate the petitioners, whose agriculture land has been illegally acquired and the fruit bearing trees have been cut for the construction of the road without adhering to the provisions of J&K Land Acquisition Act.

2. The record reveals that objections/compliance reports have also been filed on behalf of the respondents from time to time and the latest has been filed on behalf of respondent No. 2, i.e.,
Deputy Commissioner, Doda on 24.03.2025 in pursuance to the order passed by this Court on 25.02.2025, whereby a direction was issued to the said official to initiate the acquisition proceedings with regard to land measuring 03 Kanals & 19 Marlas after obtaining the necessary indent from the Chief Engineer, PMGSY, Jammu within a period of four weeks and a fresh compliance report was directed to be filed in this regard.
3.

In compliance to the aforesaid order, a compliance report has been filed on behalf of respondent No. 2-Deputy Commissioner, Doda, in which a specific stand has been taken that the acquisition proceedings for construction of Kilhotran to Pora Bala road including the land of the petitioners were under process, but due to non-depositing of funds timely by the Indenting Department, the proceedings under Sections 6 & 7 stood lapsed, as a consequence thereof, the respondent No. 2 has requested the Indenting Department (PMGSY) to deposit the awarded amount of the road in question for its disbursement amongst the interested land owners including the petitioners without disclosing the steps taken by the respondents in furtherance of the direction passed by this Court Shanti Parkash And Anr vs State Of J&K And Ors on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28971599/
1 vide order dated 25.02.2025, wherein a categoric direction was issued to the Deputy Commissioner,
Doda to initiate the acquisition proceedings with regard to the land in question.

entities.text: Shanti Parkash And Anr vs State Of J&K And Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The compliance report is silent in this regard and this Court is not aware what steps have been taken by the respondents in furtherance of the aforesaid direction.
4.

In the aforesaid backdrop, the respondent No. 2 is directed to file a fresh compliance report with a view to apprise this Court the steps taken in furtherance of the directions passed by this Court vide order dated 25.02.2025 and also to explain whether the acquisition proceedings have been initiated or not and if initiated, whether the compensation has been paid to the lawful claimants including the petitioners.

5. Let the needful be done within a period of two weeks from today with copy in advance to the learned counsel for the petitioners, failing which, this Court will be constrained to initiate coercive measures against the respondents.
6. List on 28.05.2025.
(Wasim Sadiq Nargal) Judge Jammu 08.04.2025 Ram Krishan Shanti Parkash And Anr vs State Of J&K And Ors on 8 April, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/28971599/
2
